workLog.task: Measure all four causal-graph issues against live main
workLog.outcome: #3350 confirmed (41 of 255 episodes orphaned), #3356 confirmed (7 node types, 4 in the enum), #3367 confirmed (13 unreproducible ids, 5 colliding), #3375's symptom absent from main but its mechanism live.

Git hands a merge driver the common ancestor, so presence in it discriminates removed from never-held. Six-line change, no schema field. Proved by replaying the real 663bbac48 purge through git: resurrects on the old driver, does not on the new.
Audited all 85 commits that touched the graph. 3 removed rows, all deliberate (663bbac48, c2264799b, bdacb6b19). The generator only ever adds.

workLog.task: Establish that the 13 bad ids are unrecoverable (#3367 AC 1)
workLog.outcome: Exhaustive sweep on the simplest node: 12 types by 8 label variants by 8 separators by 8 hash algorithms plus every truncation length, over 3840 hypotheses, zero hits.
repair_causal_graph_ids folds 5 colliding pairs and renames 8, moving 5 edges. Nodes 1849 to 1844, edges 57 unchanged, all 214 episodes preserved, every fold kept the earlier created.

workLog.task: Add the guard #3367 AC 3 asks for
workLog.outcome: The class already asserted a pattern id derives from its name; the node sibling did not exist. Added it plus duplicate-id and edge-endpoint checks.
update_causal_graph already takes a directory and is idempotent. No new backfill script was needed; the gap was that nothing ran it and nothing detected the drift.

workLog.task: Find and fix a defect the backfill would have shipped
workLog.outcome: A full reconciliation left 3 edges pointing at retracted nodes. Pre-#3034 edges carry no episode provenance so episode-scoped retraction cannot reach them. Added a structural sweep.
All 255 episodes now represented, 0 orphans, 0 dangling edges, 0 duplicate ids, no created timestamp moved on any pre-existing node.

Ten controls run, all bit: removing the survives filter (7 red including the real-git replay), over-dropping additions (14), reintroducing a bad node id, a dangling edge, a duplicate id, disabling the edge repoint (3), disabling the created fold (2), unwiring the orphan sweep (1), and dropping one episode's provenance (1).
The NUL-byte contributions keys are deliberate: _LEGACY_PREFIX reserves a byte that cannot appear in an episode id. No issue filed.

nextSteps: #3356 needs the schema widened to the 7 node types the generator emits and the sequential id patterns dropped, since content-derived identity is the only form that survives a union merge.
